sections.heading: Why Debugging is Different
sections.content: LLMs are stochastic. Debugging focuses on prompts, context and evaluation. Treat it as iterative design, not just code fixes.

sections.heading: Checklist
content: Is the instruction clear and specific?
Are we constraining the output format?
Do we have tests to prevent regressions?

sections.heading: Hands‑on (Run Test)
sections.description: Create 2–3 small tests for a prompt (expected outputs), run them, then adjust the prompt until tests pass.
steps: Write a simple prompt and 2 expected outputs
Run the tests and inspect failures
Re‑run tests and keep the passing cases

quiz.question: Which is a good first step when results are inconsistent?
Why keep a small test suite?

options.b: To detect regressions when prompts change
